Overhaul v1.3.1e (9 June 2021) |previous_update = [[Overhaul v1.2|April Fools 2021 Update]] |next_update = [[Overhaul v1.4]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Overhaul v1.3''' was the twenty-eighth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 8th of May 2021. This update is notable for bringing the [[Frost Invasion Event]], the seventh event in Tower Defense Simulator. Unlike with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was an official name for this update, that being the '''Frost Invasion Update'''. '''Overhaul v1.3''' has been retroactively applied to this update to keep in line with the numbering scheme with the other updates. This version encompassed ten updates, the main Overhaul v1.3.0 update (released 8 May 2021) and nine minor updates, the Overhaul v1.3.0a (released the same day as Overhaul v1.3.0, 8 May 2021),
